mapper.sql: id, employee_no, user_id, name, gender, mobile, email, department_id, position_id, grade, manager_id, work_location, hire_date, employment_type, employment_status, last_work_day, probation_pay_ratio, probation_end_date, deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM employee WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT e.id, e.employee_no, e.user_id, e.name, e.gender, e.mobile, e.email, e.department_id, e.position_id, e.grade, e.manager_id, e.work_location, e.hire_date, e.employment_type, e.employment_status, e.last_work_day, e.probation_pay_ratio, e.probation_end_date, e.deleted, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM employee e WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0 ${dataScope}
SELECT FROM employee WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM employee WHERE mobile = #{mobile} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM employee WHERE mobile = #{mobile} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (employee_no, user_id, name, gender, mobile, email, department_id, position_id, grade, manager_id, work_location, hire_date, employment_type, employment_status, last_work_day, probation_pay_ratio, probation_end_date) VALUES (#{employeeNo}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{mobile}, #{email}, #{departmentId}, #{positionId}, #{grade}, #{managerId}, #{workLocation}, #{hireDate}, #{employmentType}, #{employmentStatus}, #{lastWorkDay}, #{probationPayRatio}, #{probationEndDate})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM employee WHERE deleted = 0 AND employment_status = 10 AND probation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND probation_end_date <= #{to} ORDER BY probation_end_date ASC, id ASC
